# DataAcquisition schemas
{: .no_toc}

Type-specific details of the data recorded in a session.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## How to use this family

- [`dataacquisition`](/api/modules/dataacquisition/): set `type` to a type code below and send its properties in `details`.
- [`dataacquisitiontemplate`](/api/modules/dataacquisitiontemplate/): set `type` to a type code below and send its properties in `details`.
- Every version is published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/DataAcquisition/<Type>/<version>.json` and never changes; `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/DataAcquisition/<Type>.json` is the current version and `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/DataAcquisition/<Type>/` lists the versions. See [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/).
- Quantities are objects `{"value": <number>, "unit": "<code>"}`. Property paths with `[]` are inside a repeatable list of rows. The server sets the schema version field itself.

## Audio and Behavior Tracking

### Audio

- type code `Audio` · version 1.1.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/DataAcquisition/Audio/1.1.1.json)

A recorded sound signal, such as vocalizations or an acoustic monitor. Use this for the audio signal itself; a sound used as a stimulus is a Manipulation.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `fileName` | File name | text |  |  | The name of the audio file including the extension (e.g., 'track.mp3'). This identifies the file on storage media or file systems. |
| `format` | Format | text |  |  | The file format or container type of the audio file (e.g., MP3, WAV, AAC). Different formats may support various features like metadata, compression, and copyright management. |
| `compression` | Compression | text |  |  | Describes whether the audio is compressed losslessly or lossily, and the type of compression used if applicable. This affects audio quality and file size. |
| `bitDepth` | Bit depth | integer |  | ≥ 0; default `8` | The number of bits of information in each sample, which determines the dynamic range and noise level of the audio. Common values are 8, 16, 24, or 32 bits. |
| `codec` | Codec | text |  |  | The codec used to encode or decode the audio (e.g., FLAC, ALAC, Opus). The choice of codec affects compatibility with playback devices and audio quality. |
| `nChannels` | Number of channels | integer |  | ≥ 1; default `2` | The number of separate audio channels (e.g., 1 for mono, 2 for stereo, more for surround sound configurations). This affects the spatial representation of sound. |
| `nSamples` | Number of samples | integer |  | ≥ 0 | The total number of audio samples in the file. This number, along with the sampling rate, can determine the total duration of the audio. |
| `sr` | Sampling rate | quantity with unit |  | units `GHz`, `MHz`, `kHz`, `Hz`; default `{"unit": "Hz"}` | The sampling rate of the audio, which is the number of samples of audio carried per second. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "fileName": "text",
    "format": "text"
}
```

- `interfaces` accepts ExperimentalInterface types: [`SiliconProbe`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#silicon-probe), [`Tetrode`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#tetrode), [`SingleWireElectrode`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#single-wire-electrode), [`Generic`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#generic-interface), [`Microphone`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#microphone); other values are refused (400).

### Behavioral Tracking

- type code `BehavioralTracking` · version 1.1.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/DataAcquisition/BehavioralTracking/1.1.1.json)

Derived or processed tracking data: positions, markers, key points or poses produced by a tracking system such as an OptiTrack motion-capture rig or a pose-estimation pipeline. Use this when the stored stream is the processed points; the raw footage is Video tracking.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `fileName` | File name | text |  |  | The name of the file containing behavioral tracking data, typically including the file extension (e.g., 'session1.avi'). |
| `format` | Format | text |  |  | The video or data file format (e.g., MP4, AVI) used to store behavioral tracking information. |
| `compression` | Compression | text |  |  | Type of compression used to reduce the file size of the behavioral tracking data, if applicable. |
| `nFrames` | Number of frames | integer |  | ≥ 0 | Total number of frames included in the behavioral tracking session, which determines the total duration of the recorded data. |
| `verticalResolution` | Vertical resolution | integer |  | ≥ 0 | The number of vertical pixels in each frame, which affects the clarity and detail visible in the behavioral tracking video. |
| `horizontalResolution` | Horizontal resolution | integer |  | ≥ 0 | The number of horizontal pixels in each frame, which affects the clarity and detail visible in the behavioral tracking video. |
| `frameRate` | Frame rate | quantity with unit |  | units `GHz`, `MHz`, `kHz`, `Hz`; default `{"unit": "Hz"}` | The number of frames per second at which the behavioral data was recorded, affecting the smoothness and accuracy of motion analysis. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "fileName": "text",
    "format": "text"
}
```

- `interfaces` accepts ExperimentalInterface types: [`Camera`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#camera), [`TrackingSystem`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#tracking-system); other values are refused (400).

## Electrophysiology

### Electroencephalography (EEG)

- type code `Electroencephalography` · version 1.1.2 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/DataAcquisition/Electroencephalography/1.1.2.json)

Large-scale electrical activity recorded from electrodes on or beneath the skull rather than from within the tissue. Also use this type for ECoG surface arrays, or Extracellular Electrophysiology when a dense array is recorded on a probe system with electrode groups and channel tags.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `fileName` | File name | text |  |  | The name of the file containing EEG data, typically including the file extension (e.g., '.edf'). This file stores brain wave patterns recorded during EEG sessions. |
| `format` | Format | text |  |  | The digital file format of the EEG data (e.g., EDF, BDF). This format determines how data is organized, stored, and how compatible it is with various EEG analysis software. |
| `type` | Data-type | text |  | default `"int16"` | Specifies the data type used to store the EEG signals (e.g., 'int16' for 16-bit integers), which impacts the data's precision and storage size. |
| `nChannels` | Number of channels | integer |  | ≥ 0 | Number of separately recorded EEG channels. |
| `nSamples` | Number of samples | integer |  | ≥ 0 | The total number of data points recorded per channel, which determines the total duration of the EEG recording when combined with the sampling rate. |
| `sr` | Sampling rate | quantity with unit |  | units `GHz`, `MHz`, `kHz`, `Hz`; default `{"value": 20000, "unit": "Hz"}` | The frequency at which the EEG signals are sampled per second, crucial for capturing the temporal dynamics of brain activity. Higher rates provide more detailed time resolution. |
| `lsb` | Least significant bit | quantity with unit |  | units `V`, `mV`, `µV`, `nV`; default `{"unit": "µV"}` | The smallest measurable change in voltage detectable by the EEG equipment, which affects the amplitude resolution of the recorded brain wave signals. |
| `electrodeGroups` | Electrode groups | table of rows |  | format table | Named channel groupings used to describe the recording layout. |
| `electrodeGroups[].channels` | List of channels | list of integers |  | format comma-separated-integers | Channel numbers assigned to this electrode group. |
| `electrodeGroups[].label` | Label | text |  |  | A descriptive label for the electrode group, aiding in identifying the function or location of the group within the EEG setup. |
| `channelTags` | Channel tags | table of rows |  | format table | Tags that associate recorded channels with roles or analysis groupings. |
| `channelTags[].tag` | Channel tag | text |  |  | A tag that categorizes or adds metadata to channels, helping to identify their roles or characteristics in the EEG data. |
| `channelTags[].channels` | List of channels | list of integers |  | format comma-separated-integers | Channel numbers assigned to this channel tag. |
| `channelTags[].groups` | Electrode groups | list of integers |  | format comma-separated-integers | Electrode-group numbers associated with this channel tag. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "fileName": "text",
    "format": "text"
}
```

- `interfaces` accepts ExperimentalInterface types: [`SiliconProbe`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#silicon-probe), [`Tetrode`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#tetrode), [`SingleWireElectrode`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#single-wire-electrode), [`EEG`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#eeg), [`ECoG`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#ecog), [`ReferenceElectrode`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#reference-electrode), [`GroundElectrode`](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/#ground-electrode); other values are refused (400).

### Electroneurogram (ENG)

- type code `Electroneurogram` · version 1.1.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/DataAcquisition/Electroneurogram/1.1.1.json)

Electrical activity recorded from a peripheral nerve, typically through a nerve cuff or hook electrode.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `fileName` | File name | text |  |  | The name of the file containing electroneurogram data, often indicating the type of neural activity recorded (e.g., 'nerve_activity.edf'). |
| `format` | Format | text |  |  | The digital format of the electroneurogram data (e.g., CSV, EDF). This format dictates how the data can be accessed and analyzed using various software tools. |
| `type` | Data-type | text |  | default `"int16"` | Specifies the data type used to store the electrical signals from nerve activity (e.g., 'int16' for 16-bit integers), affecting the precision and size of the data. |
| `nChannels` | Number of channels | integer |  | ≥ 0 | The number of separate recording channels, each capturing signals from different nerves or different locations on a single nerve, enhancing the detail and scope of analysis. |
| `nSamples` | Number of samples | integer |  | ≥ 0 | The total number of data points collected per channel, determining the total duration of the recording when combined with the sampling rate. |
| `sr` | Sampling rate | quantity with unit |  | units `GHz`, `MHz`, `kHz`, `Hz`; default `{"value": 20000, "unit": "Hz"}` | The frequency at which the neural data is sampled, crucial for capturing the rapid electrical changes that occur during nerve activation. |
| `lsb` | Least significant bit | quantity with unit |  | units `V`, `mV`, `µV`, `nV`; default `{"unit": "µV"}` | The smallest detectable change in signal by the recording system, affecting the amplitude resolution of the neural activity measurements. |
| `electrodeGroups` | Electrode groups | table of rows |  | format table | Named channel groupings used to describe the recording layout. |
| `electrodeGroups[].channels` | List of channels | list of integers |  | format comma-separated-integers | Channel numbers assigned to this electrode group. |
| `electrodeGroups[].label` | Label | text |  |  | A label identifying the electrode group, useful for referencing during analysis or reporting. |
| `channelTags` | Channel tags | table of rows |  | format table | Tags that associate recorded channels with roles or analysis groupings. |
| `channelTags[].tag` | Channel tag | text |  |  | A descriptive tag providing additional information about the role or characteristics of a channel in the recording setup. |
| `channelTags[].channels` | List of channels | list of integers |  | format comma-separated-integers | Channel numbers assigned to this channel tag. |
| `channelTags[].groups` | Electrode groups | list of integers |  | format comma-separated-integers | Electrode-group numbers associated with this channel tag. |

| `lsb` | Least significant bit | quantity with unit |  | units `V`, `mV`, `µV`, `nV`; default `{"unit": "µV"}` | The smallest detectable change in voltage by the recording equipment, influencing the resolution and sensitivity of the measurements. |

### Intracellular Electrophysiology

- type code `IntracellularEphys` · version 1.1.2 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/DataAcquisition/IntracellularEphys/1.1.2.json)

Membrane potential or current recorded from inside a single cell, as in whole-cell patch or sharp-electrode recordings.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |

| `type` | Data-type | text |  | default `"int16"` | Specifies the data type used to store the electrical signals (e.g., 'int16' for 16-bit integers), affecting the precision and size of the data. |
| `nChannels` | Number of channels | integer |  | ≥ 0 | The number of separate recording channels, each possibly recording from different cells or different parts of a cell, providing a comprehensive view of neural activity. |
| `nSamples` | Number of samples | integer |  | ≥ 0 | The total number of data points collected per channel, defining the duration and extent of the recording session when combined with the sampling rate. |
| `sr` | Sampling rate | quantity with unit |  | units `GHz`, `MHz`, `kHz`, `Hz`; default `{"unit": "Hz"}` | The frequency at which the electrical signals inside the neuron are sampled per second, crucial for capturing the rapid changes in voltage that occur during neuronal activity. |

## Optical Imaging

### Confocal Microscopy

- type code `ConfocalMicroscopy` · version 1.1.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/DataAcquisition/ConfocalMicroscopy/1.1.1.json)

Imaging that rejects out-of-focus light with a pinhole to produce optical sections.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `fileName` | File name | text |  |  | The name of the file containing confocal microscopy images, typically including the file extension (e.g., '.tif'). |
| `format` | Format | text |  |  | The digital format of the confocal microscopy data (e.g., TIFF, JPEG, or specialized microscopy formats), which affects the compatibility with analysis software. |
| `compression` | Compression | text |  |  | Describes whether the image files are stored using lossless or lossy compression, which impacts file size and image quality. |
| `verticalResolution` | Vertical resolution | integer |  | ≥ 0 | The number of pixels in the vertical dimension of each image, influencing the level of detail and clarity in the image. |

### General time-series

- type code `GeneralTimeSeries` · version 1.1.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/DataAcquisition/GeneralTimeSeries/1.1.1.json)

| `type` | Data-type | text |  | default `"int16"` | Specifies the data type used to store the time series values (e.g., 'int16' for 16-bit integers), influencing data precision and storage size. |
| `nChannels` | Number of channels | integer |  | ≥ 0 | The number of separate data channels recorded, each possibly representing different variables or sensors, enhancing the complexity and multidimensionality. |

| `sr` | Sampling rate | quantity with unit |  | units `GHz`, `MHz`, `kHz`, `Hz`; default `{"unit": "Hz"}` | The frequency at which data points are recorded per second, crucial for determining the temporal resolution of the time series. |
